qualification: Local command and shared drafting-input regressions. No new Rhino measurements for the interactive Custom getter.
behavior: Two world points define a direction using the existing robust Point3 direction helper; vector length and sign do not alter bidirectional projection.
Mixed source/target preselection defers projection until a valid second point.
Viewport endpoint snaps and typed world/relative coordinates, units, point filters and constraints use shared drafting input.
Undo within the getter revises its start without modifying document history. Cancel restores original selection and preserves the last accepted custom direction.
Headless Direction=Custom requires explicit DirectionStart and DirectionEnd world points; invalid or conflicting inputs preserve document and redo history.

checks.portable_app_exclusion_reason: Stopped the optional broad run after this unrelated test continued for several minutes; reran the remaining app suite successfully.

limitations: Interactive Rhino parity and comparative performance remain unqualified.
Existing Project geometry discovery, clipping, topology and feature limitations still apply.
